create_squeeze_excitation_layer: create a SqueezeAndExcitationLayer with a given number of input planes and default reduction ratio of 16
create_squeeze_excitation_custom_reducti: create a SqueezeAndExcitationLayer with a custom reduction ratio to control channel bottleneck size
create_squeeze_excitation_reduced_planes: create a SqueezeAndExcitationLayer with explicit reduced_planes instead of a reduction ratio
create_squeeze_excitation_custom_activat: create a SqueezeAndExcitationLayer with a custom activation module instead of the default ReLU
run_squeeze_excitation_forward: run the forward pass of SqueezeAndExcitationLayer on a 4D tensor to apply channel-wise attention scaling
